# **normality**

An R package as a toolkit of statistical approaches for assessing data
normality.

There are also other nice alternatives such as
[`nortest`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=nortest),
[`moments`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=moments),
[`cmstatr`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=cmstatr), and other
friends.

# Installation

You can install the package from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=normality) with:

``` r

install.packages("normality")
```

or the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/P10911004-NPUST/normality) with:

``` r

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("P10911004-NPUST/normality")
```

# Quick start

``` r

is_normal(rnorm(20), summary = TRUE)
```

[`skewness()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/skewness.md)

[`kurtosis()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/kurtosis.md)

[`D.Agostino_Pearson_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/D.Agostino_Pearson_test.md)

### 4. Regression and correlation:

[`Shapiro_Wilk_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Shapiro_Wilk_test.md)
with 3 alternatives:

- [Shapiro-Wilk](https://doi.org/10.2307/2333709)
- [Shapiro-Francia](https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.1972.10481232)
- [Shapiro-Wilk-Royston](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01891203)

`Ryan_Joiner_test()`
[pdf](https://www.additive-net.de/de/component/jdownloads/send/70-support/236-normal-probability-plots-and-tests-for-normality-thomas-a-ryan-jr-bryan-l-joiner)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Anderson_Darling_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Anderson_Darling_test.md)
  : Anderson-Darling Normality Test

- [`check_normality()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/check_normality.md)
  : Normality test

- [`Cramer_von_Mises_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Cramer_von_Mises_test.md)
  : Cramer-von Mises Normality Test

- [`D.Agostino_Pearson_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/D.Agostino_Pearson_test.md)
  :

  D'Agostino–Pearson K² Normality Test

- [`is_normal()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/is_normal.md)
  : Normality test

- [`is_tied()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/is_tied.md)
  : Tied data

- [`Jarque_Bera_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Jarque_Bera_test.md)
  : Jarque-Bera Normality Test

- [`kurtosis()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/kurtosis.md)
  : Kurtosis test

- [`Lilliefors_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Lilliefors_test.md)
  : Lilliefors Normality Test

- [`normality_standard_output()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/normality_standard_output.md)
  : Standard output format

- [`Shapiro_Wilk_coef_table`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Shapiro_Wilk_coef_table.md)
  : Shapiro-Wilk normality test (coefficients)

- [`Shapiro_Wilk_pval_table`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Shapiro_Wilk_pval_table.md)
  : Shapiro-Wilk normality test (p-values)

- [`Shapiro_Wilk_test()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/Shapiro_Wilk_test.md)
  : Shapiro-Wilk Normality Test

- [`skewness()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/normality/reference/skewness.md)
  : Skewness test
